findings.evidence: vscode-extension/src/controller/workspace-controller.ts:349-361 converts each declared glob to its static directory prefix before supplying writableRoots; for example src/foo*.ts grants the src directory rather than only matching files. vscode-extension/src/controller/approval-broker.ts:55-71 performs lexical resolve/relative checks but no filesystem realpath, symlink, or junction containment check. docs/security.md:24 promises post-resolution workflow-path checking. Current unit evidence asserts emitted policies, while EVID-046/EVID-055 exercised a read-only live turn with zero authorized writes, so no real app-server test proves sibling, glob-expansion, or symlink escape denial under workspaceWrite.
findings.recommendation: Do not translate file globs into broader writable directories. Use an isolated task checkout or another enforcement layer that admits only exact declared matches, realpath every existing path component, reject symlink/junction escapes, and add live adversarial tests covering one allowed write plus denied sibling, widened-glob, traversal, and symlink-target writes.
findings.title: Scoped workspace-write containment remains broader than declared task paths

findings.evidence: .agents/skills/devweave/scripts/devweave_v2/run_git_coordinator.py:101-110 passes the active ExecPlan as an ignored path to commit_slice, and :127-132 filters it from source status. .agents/skills/devweave/scripts/devweave_v2/run_service.py:286-299 commits source before mutating the task record. .agents/skills/devweave/scripts/devweave_v2/host_facade.py:105-127 records Gate decisions and moves the plan to completed without creating a Git commit. This conflicts with requirements.md REQ-006 and AC-006/AC-007, design.md's requirement that slice commits stage declared paths plus ExecPlan, and AC-022 recovery expectations. The completed canonical plan can therefore remain untracked/dirty and is not recoverable from the asserted phase commits.
findings.recommendation: Make each approved Gate and completed vertical slice atomically produce a scoped checkpoint containing the authoritative post-transition ExecPlan and relevant declared source paths. Commit the completed archive transition, verify commit_ref points to the checkpoint containing the recorded state, and test crash recovery, repository loss reconstruction, archive tracking, and clean preflight for the next run.
findings.title: Canonical ExecPlan and Gate lifecycle are still absent from Git recovery checkpoints

findings.evidence: .devweave/work-items/20260825-163914-feature-devweave-v2-app-server-harness/acceptance.md:46 reports CLI 23/23, while the bounded raw log for current EVID-049 reports Ran 24 tests with an OK result.
findings.recommendation: Change the acceptance claim to CLI 24/24 and retain its EVID-049 binding so the human-readable acceptance record exactly matches the machine evidence.
findings.title: Acceptance understates the current CLI test count

summary: Resolution review at HEAD 0a276e6d88197b250c01935c66212051ad5ceced confirms F-002, F-003, F-004, F-006, F-007, and the substantive audit-currentness portion of F-008 are resolved. F-001 remains critical because declared task globs are widened into directory-level writable roots without realpath-safe containment.
